summary: Build practical AI workflows for inboxes, calendars, meetings, and drafting. Train your support team to work faster with confidence.
lede: AI productivity for administrative and executive assistants combines AI assistants, workflow automation, and productivity platforms to reduce repetitive effort and strengthen executive support. You will learn to draft emails and documents faster, manage inboxes and calendars more effectively, prepare meeting materials, summarize information, and support reliable follow-through. The course turns everyday tool familiarity into practical systems for scheduling, meeting briefs, task automation, and document summaries. Through hands-on executive support scenarios, you will also explore reusable prompts, automation mapping, confidentiality controls, bias awareness, and approval steps for AI-generated content.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already support executives or office operations and want to use AI more confidently in daily administrative work.
prerequisites: Participants should have basic experience in administrative or executive support work and familiarity with common office productivity tools such as Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace. No coding is required. Access to a laptop and a current productivity platform is recommended for practical exercises, and prior exposure to calendar management, email handling, minute writing, or meeting coordination will help you move faster through the applied activities. Advanced AI concepts are covered at an operational application level, not at a technical engineering level.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
